sections.title: The Final Calculation
sections.intent: Establish the protagonist's death and transition into the system.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist stands before the Tutorial Gate.

sections.title: Debugging the Tutorial
sections.intent: Explore the mechanics of the 100% crit bug.
sections.end_condition: The tutorial boss spawns in the arena.

sections.title: One-Shot Wonder
sections.intent: Conclude the tutorial by obliterating the boss.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist enters the portal to the hub city.

sections.title: The Iron Gate Bureaucracy
sections.intent: Introduce the hub city and the protagonist's initial struggle with registration.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist successfully registers at the Adventurer Guild.

sections.title: The Agility Loophole
sections.intent: Experiment with the Speed-to-Crit conversion in a controlled environment.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist achieves a stable 100% crit-rate via Agility stacking.

sections.title: Dressed for Success
sections.intent: Acquire the necessary gear to leverage the exploit in a real dungeon.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist steps into the entrance of the Sunken Crypt.

sections.title: The No-Hit Run
sections.intent: Begin the Sunken Crypt clear using the zero-hit strategy.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist reaches the mid-dungeon checkpoint without taking damage.

sections.title: Breaking the Leaderboard
sections.intent: Escalate the dungeon difficulty while maintaining the hitless streak.
sections.end_condition: The final boss door of the Sunken Crypt opens.

sections.title: Crypt-ic Victory
sections.intent: Defeat the dungeon boss and trigger the server-wide leaderboard alert.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist exits the dungeon as the #1 ranked player.

sections.title: The Patch is Coming
sections.intent: Gather intelligence on the upcoming nerf and locate the Admin Vault.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist identifies the exact location of the Luck-Stabilizer.

sections.title: Heist of the Century
sections.intent: Navigate the vault's security systems using movement exploits.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist enters the vault's inner containment field.

sections.title: The Great Escape
sections.intent: Secure the Luck-Stabilizer and flee the city before the gates lock.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist escapes the city walls as the bounty goes live.

sections.title: The Dead-Zone
sections.intent: Enter the lawless Dead-Zone and encounter the System Corrector.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist loses the Corrector's tail for the first time.

sections.title: Pathfinding Pranks
sections.intent: Use environmental hazards and mob aggro to evade the Corrector.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist reaches the entrance of the Source Code Temple.

sections.title: The Source Code Sanctuary
sections.intent: Locate the hidden temple where the world's logic is exposed.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist interfaces with the world's core logic terminal.

sections.title: Setting the Trap
sections.intent: Prepare the unstable zone for a massive mathematical overflow.
sections.end_condition: The Corrector enters the lag-trap zone.

sections.title: Division by Zero
sections.intent: Engage the Corrector in a battle that pushes the physics engine to its limit.
sections.end_condition: The environment begins to visually glitch as the overflow starts.

sections.title: Entity Deleted
sections.intent: Trigger the overflow error to remove the Corrector from existence.
sections.end_condition: The Corrector is purged from the system registry.

sections.title: The Glitch Frontier
sections.intent: Claim the unstable zone as a permanent base of operations.
sections.end_condition: The Glitch Zone's perimeter is secured against system scans.

sections.title: The New Meta
sections.intent: Form a guild of outliers and establish the rules of the new reality.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist sits on the 'Throne of Exploits' as the new update begins.
